screen.kinetrix.emotes.hint: Move, attack or get hit to stop
message.kinetrix.crawl_needs_server: Crawling needs Kinetrix on the server too
screen.kinetrix.gallery.world: World only: not in the preview
kinetrix.demo.stand.desc: Standing still: weight shifting from foot to foot, soft knees and elbows, breathing.
kinetrix.demo.walk.desc: Walking: the swinging knee bends, shoulders counter-swing, the body sways.
kinetrix.demo.sprint.desc: Sprinting: leaning in, long strides, pumping elbows, a springy bounce.
kinetrix.demo.brake.desc: Stopping out of a sprint: momentum carries the chest on, the front foot braces.
kinetrix.demo.sneak.desc: Holding Shift: leaning, careful steps on bent legs, looking round when still.
kinetrix.demo.crawl.desc: Holding C (or squeezed under a trapdoor): a low crawl, fits through one-block gaps.
kinetrix.demo.jump.desc: Jumping on the spot: knees tucked up.
kinetrix.demo.run_jump.desc: Jumping on the run: the leading leg alternates.
kinetrix.demo.fall.desc: Falling: arms up in a Y, legs flailing; legs absorb the landing.
kinetrix.demo.elytra.desc: Gliding: arms back along the body, legs together, shaking in the wind.
kinetrix.demo.fly.desc: Flying in creative: hovering, legs dangling.
kinetrix.demo.land_soft.desc: A drop of 1–3 blocks: the legs absorb it.
kinetrix.demo.land_hard.desc: A high drop with no movement keys: a deep crouch.
kinetrix.demo.land_roll.desc: A high drop holding W: a short forward roll.
kinetrix.demo.land_backroll.desc: Falling backwards off a ledge holding S: lying back, then a back roll on touchdown.
kinetrix.demo.land_sword.desc: A high drop with a sword and no W: point down in the air, a wind-up near the ground, then down on one knee driving it into the ground.
kinetrix.demo.land_dual.desc: The same with a sword in each hand: both go in.
kinetrix.demo.sword_draw.desc: A one-handed sword comes into your hand: it spins once, upright and toward you, then you step into the guard, which fades without attacks.
kinetrix.demo.sword_draw_off.desc: A sword put in your other hand (also with F) spins there too.
kinetrix.demo.sword_guard.desc: After every sword swing (even at the air): ~2.5 s side-on, low, arms wide, standing or walking.
kinetrix.demo.sword_combo.desc: Left-click combo: sweep, rising cut, overhead chop, spinning slash, with a trail.
kinetrix.demo.sword_shield.desc: With a shield in the other hand the guard keeps the shield up in front.
kinetrix.demo.sword_run.desc: Sprinting with a sword: the sword arm trails out to the side and back, blade toward the ground.
kinetrix.demo.dual_run.desc: Both arms trail; jumps and short drops keep it, stopping, a hit or a real fall end it.
kinetrix.demo.axe.desc: Left-click with an axe: heavy one-handed chops.
kinetrix.demo.fists.desc: Left-click empty-handed: alternating punches, then a boxing guard.
kinetrix.demo.idle_stretch.desc: Idle with empty hands (about every 10 s standing still): arms up, leaning side to side.
kinetrix.demo.idle_look.desc: Idle: hands on hips, looking slowly about.
kinetrix.demo.idle_neck.desc: Idle: tilting the head to crack the neck, rolling the shoulders.
kinetrix.demo.idle_kick.desc: Idle: looking down and kicking a pebble away.
kinetrix.demo.idle_spin.desc: Idle with a sword (or shovel, rod): twirling it.
kinetrix.demo.idle_inspect.desc: Idle with a sword or axe: looking it over, running a hand along the blade.
kinetrix.demo.idle_practice.desc: Idle with a weapon or pickaxe: a couple of swings at the air.
kinetrix.demo.idle_shoulder.desc: Idle with a tool: resting it on the shoulder.
kinetrix.demo.idle_lean.desc: Idle with a shovel, hoe or trident: leaning on it with both hands.
kinetrix.demo.idle_flint.desc: Idle: clicking it twice, watching the sparks.
kinetrix.demo.idle_bucket.desc: Idle: peering into the bucket, swinging it.
kinetrix.demo.idle_rod.desc: Idle: tugging at the line, a test flick.
kinetrix.demo.idle_lantern.desc: Idle: holding it up, looking round by its light.
kinetrix.demo.idle_block.desc: Idle: turning a block over in the hand.
kinetrix.demo.idle_dual_draw.desc: Idle with two swords: drawn from behind the back into a wary crouch, looking round.
kinetrix.demo.idle_dual_spin.desc: Idle with two swords: twirled one after the other.
kinetrix.demo.doze.desc: A minute of doing nothing at all, whatever you hold: nodding off on your feet, "Z z z" floating up one at a time. Any action wakes you.
kinetrix.demo.emote.desc: From the emote menu (key B). Others see it too; moving, attacking or getting hurt stops it.
kinetrix.demo.menu_think.desc: Inventory, crafting table, pause menu or another mod's menu open: chin on the fist.
kinetrix.demo.menu_rummage.desc: A chest, barrel, furnace or any container open: rummaging with both hands, looking down.
kinetrix.demo.menu_trade.desc: Trading with a villager: a tap on the sleeve, then talking with the hands.
kinetrix.demo.sleep_starfish.desc: In bed (a random pose every time): sprawled out like a starfish.
kinetrix.demo.sleep_face_down.desc: In bed: face down, an arm under the pillow.
kinetrix.demo.sleep_hands_behind.desc: In bed: on the back, hands behind the head, a knee up.
kinetrix.demo.sit_back.desc: Key X: sitting on the ground leaning back on the hands, a knee up.
kinetrix.demo.sit_knee.desc: Key X: one knee up with an arm on it.
kinetrix.demo.hit_front.desc: Hurt from the front: knocked back, arms forward.
kinetrix.demo.hit_back.desc: Hurt from behind: pushed forward, arms back.
kinetrix.demo.explosion.desc: An explosion nearby: shielding the face.
kinetrix.demo.explosion_sword.desc: Thrown back, bracing on the sword planted in the ground, sliding back.
kinetrix.demo.totem.desc: Saved by a Totem of Undying: staring at the hands, dazed.
kinetrix.demo.swim.desc: Sprint-swimming: front crawl, a smooth climb out.
kinetrix.demo.tread.desc: In deep water without sprinting: upright, legs eggbeating.
kinetrix.demo.dive.desc: Jumping into water from 1.5+ blocks: a head-first dive.
kinetrix.demo.ladder.desc: On a ladder or vines: hand over hand, feet on the rungs.
kinetrix.demo.boat.desc: Rowing; sitting still, a new pastime every few seconds.
kinetrix.demo.minecart.desc: Hands on the sides, rattling on the joints, arms up at full speed.
kinetrix.demo.horse.desc: Walk, trot, gallop, jumps, rearing, patting the neck.
kinetrix.demo.two_riders.desc: Right-click a saddled horse someone rides to sit behind them. Needs Kinetrix on the server.
kinetrix.demo.bow.desc: Drawing a bow: bow arm straight, the string hand by the string.
kinetrix.demo.crossbow.desc: Held in both hands like a shotgun.
kinetrix.demo.shield.desc: Blocking: crouched behind the shield, a recoil on every block.
kinetrix.demo.eat.desc: The food goes to the mouth, the head nods while chewing.
kinetrix.demo.trident.desc: A javelin throw; a thrust when attacking.
kinetrix.demo.fishing.desc: Cast, wait with the rod up, strike.
kinetrix.demo.mining.desc: One-handed tools; digging with the hands when empty.
kinetrix.demo.place.desc: The hand presses the block into place.
kinetrix.demo.drop.desc: Key Q: a throw, alternating hands.
kinetrix.demo.swap.desc: Key F: the hands meet in the middle (a sword spins instead).
kinetrix.demo.spell.desc: With Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks: a caster's stance by school, a recoil at the end.
